{{Youmay|the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] [[Bay 15 (Marka Durn)|docking bay]] used by [[Marka Durn]]|the [[canon]] [[Bay 15|docking bay]] on [[Toshaal]]}}
'''Bay 15''' was located in an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] just off the [[Nanth'ri Route]]. [[Marka Durn]] berthed his [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Deephopper]]'' in Bay 15 when he went looked for an [[Marka Durn's associate|old friend]] in the spaceport.<ref name="TCM">{{WEGCite|story=The Treasure of Celis Mott|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>
